findingsReadOnlyPartial: Files in at least {count} object(s) of {name} can be read but not changed.

navigationFilesPending: The files of this destination cannot be listed here yet.
stateDenied: You do not have permission to see this
stateUnavailable: This is not available right now
hostDesktop: Your files stay on this device. Only you can read them.
hostDesktopBackup: Backup copies are encrypted on this device before upload.
hostServer: Your files are stored on a server run by {operator}. That operator can read them. Other users see only what they are permitted to.
hostOperatorUnnamed: an operator who has not given a name
hostServerAtRest: Protecting this server's storage at rest is the operator's disk or bucket encryption.
hostBrowser: Your files are decrypted only in this browser.
hostNotEnrolled: Not enrolled. Backup and sync are off.
hostServiceCiphertext: Your files are encrypted on your device before upload. FileSquid's service stores ciphertext and never has your keys.
fileFolderPending: Pending until a file is added
filePreviewError: This file could not be loaded
fileMoreToLoad: More items are not loaded yet
fileFolderCreated: Folder {name} created. It stays pending until a file is added.
fileNameInvalid: A name cannot contain / or \, control characters, and cannot be . or ..
fileNameTooLong: A name can be at most 255 bytes.
fileConflict: The files changed or another change is in progress. Reload and try again.
fileDisplayNameTooLong: A name can be at most 1,024 bytes.
fileRenameInvalid: That name cannot be used. It must be 1 to 1,024 bytes and cannot contain / or a null character.
fileRenameNotFound: That file is no longer available. Reload the list.
fileRenameConflict: That is already the name, or the file changed meanwhile. Reload and try again.
fileRenameUnavailable: The storage for this file cannot be reached now. Nothing was changed. Try again.
fileUploadSkipped: {count} files were not uploaded because one batch holds at most {limit}. Try again to upload them.
libraryIntro: Your library lives on this computer and works without a connection. No account, subscription or internet connection is needed.
libraryCreateHelp: Start a new library in an empty folder you choose. The folder becomes the OCFL storage root.
libraryOpenHelp: Open a library that is already in a folder on this computer or a connected disk. Nothing in the folder is rewritten on open.
libraryRecoverHelp: Rebuild the catalog from a copied OCFL storage root, reading its files alone. Nothing is repaired or deleted.
libraryChoosing: Waiting for you to choose a folder.
libraryCancelled: No folder was chosen. Nothing changed.
libraryChooserUnavailable: A folder cannot be chosen now. This host may have no folder chooser, the service may not be installed or started, or storage may not be reachable.
libraryConflictChoice: A folder dialog is already open, or the folder you chose cannot hold a library. Nothing changed.
libraryConflictCreate: The folder cannot become a library. It must be empty, must not be inside a folder managed by Git and must not already be open. Nothing was written.
libraryConflictOpen: The folder cannot be opened. It must hold a library, must not be inside a folder managed by Git and must not already be open. Nothing was changed.
libraryConflictCopy: The copy was refused. The destination must be an empty folder outside the library, and the library must be complete. Nothing was written.
libraryNotFound: That folder choice or library is no longer available on this host. Choose the folder again.
libraryInvalid: The request was refused as invalid. Nothing changed.
libraryFailed: The action did not finish. Nothing was reported as changed.
libraryFactFormatValue: OCFL {version} storage root, held by this host
libraryCopyHelp: Write a complete, checked copy to another empty folder. Changes made later are not copied.
libraryCopyClean: Every copied object validated without errors.
libraryRebuildHelp: Read every object from its OCFL files alone. Nothing in the library's files is written, adopted or repaired.
libraryRebuilt: Read {objects} object(s) from files. Not readable: {unreadable}. With validation errors: {invalid}.
libraryUnreadable: An object could not be opened ({code}).
libraryReadOnly: Files in {count} object(s) of this library can be read but not changed.
libraryReadOnlyPartial: Files in at least {count} object(s) of this library can be read but not changed.
repairIntro: Files in the objects below can be read but not changed, because their latest version directory has no version inventory. The repair adds it.
repairInterrupted: An earlier repair was interrupted. This completes it.
repairStaysReadOnly: Stays read-only after the repair because it uses sha512.
repairTruncated: More objects need repair than are listed here (at most {limit}). Repair these first, then review again.
repairConsent: One copy of the root inventory and its sidecar will be added to each listed object's latest version directory, and a new version recording this repair will be committed to each object's history. No file content changes.
repairRepairedNoProvenance: {object}: repaired, version {version}. Its provenance record was not written ({code}).
repairRequestRefusedOwner: Only the owner of the library can run the repair. Nothing was changed.
repairRequestRefusedConflict: The repair was refused because the consent or the library no longer matched. Nothing was changed. Review the repair again.
repairRequestRefusedGone: The library is not open on this host. Nothing was changed.
repairRequestRefusedUnavailable: The library's storage cannot be reached now. Nothing was changed. Try again.
repairRequestRefused: The repair was refused. Nothing was changed.
themeHelp: Follows the macOS appearance. Your choice is kept across launches.
settingsBuildNote: This macOS build is not signed or notarised by Apple yet.
settingsLicence: Open source under the MIT licence
settingsFormats: Library format: OCFL 1.1 · Metadata: Dublin Core terms
hostDesktopNoTelemetry: FileSquid sends nothing off this computer. No account, no telemetry.
monitorOwnerOnly: Only you can open this on this device.
appFooter: Open source under the MIT licence · Version {version} · macOS
libraryReadOnlyReason: Their latest version has no version inventory (W010).
fileNoPreviewKeep: FileSquid keeps the file and every version.
fileNoPreviewOpenElsewhere: Open it in the app that made it.
